FlowWorks: a dry pit floor is one brown gravel tone on any ground, so on dark ground it is not darker than the ground it was dug in. Measured live (ArchBig, 2 PM, shipped look, build 81ee41df54), floor grey / ground grey at 0.5 m | 2 m: Soil .81 | .56, Gravel .82 | .58, Sand .59 | .40, Marble .66 | .49, Granite .89 | .73, SoilRich 1.00 | .74, MarshyTerrain .98 | .68, Mud 1.11 | .76, Slate_Rough 1.23 | .90. A 0.5 m pit in slate draws as a brighter brown square on black rock. Cause (MOD): RM_PitReliefMath.StepK is documented as 'a multiplier on undug ground' but is laid over RM_Channel_* (gravel texture) whatever RM_MapComponent_Excavation.OriginalTerrainAt holds. The 0.5 m inversion is older than the 2026-11-23 lift (relief off: Mud 1.04, Slate 1.14); the lift moved the 2 m floor on slate from .59 to .90. Acceptance test (live, RED 2026-11-23 on 81ee41df54, 4 of 9 rows FAIL, 5 PASS): python.exe src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/northstar/pit_floor_ground_live.py on any free game exits 0 with 9 of 9 FLOOR_DARKER_THAN_ITS_GROUND_<ground> rows PASS (both floors at least 10 % darker than their own ground), and pit_floor_ladder_live.py stays 5 of 5 PASS. Not fixed in the sitting: the fix is unknown until one look question is answered, because the two fixes are different builds: (A) keep the brown gravel floor and darken it by the ground's own brightness (a per-ground factor in StepFloorShade), or (B) give the floor the material of the ground it was dug in (a slate pit has a slate floor), which also removes the brown-in-grey hue clash. Convergent or Divergent is the owner's call at filing.

The maturation tick spends 66 to 125 s per tick in build_match.deployed_hash (via ingame_facts -> read_ingame_exit -> check_visit) walking the deployed walk folder on drvfs: about 2850 scandir and 10190 stat calls build its cache key every tick, even when nothing was deployed (cProfile and RSS checkpoints in a helper clone, 2026-11-23 3:00-4:10 AM PST). On a cache miss it also reads the folder's files, and the live tick's cgroup then reads up to 499 MB of file cache (anon stayed 307 MB; 04:06 PST). Live tick walls after the page fix: 40 s to 6 min with 27 to 49 s CPU, so the wait is I/O. Launches wait on the tick. Acceptance test: none, the fix is not chosen: a cache key that skips the per-file stat is unsafe on drvfs (an in-place write moves only the file's own mtime/ctime); options to weigh are reading the walk folder's identity from deploy_custom_mods' own stamp, or reading the walk build once per deploy instead of once per tick.
